Thermotec NuWrap 5 is a highly flexible acoustic pipe insulation product formulated with the latest visco-elastic 
polymer technology. It is faced with a reinforced fire resistant aluminium foil and bonded to a high performance 
acoustic foam. NuWrap 5 is suitable for waste pipes, ductwork and a wide range of applications.
“Delivering Australian made insulation excellence for 37 years”
